body_text:
A subsequence of $(a_n)$ is a sequence $(a_{n_k})$ whose index
map $k\mapsto n_k$ is strictly increasing. If $a_n\to L$, then
every subsequence also converges to $L$. The converse fails
unless additional information controls all indices.
